text: Susanoo raged across heaven, wrecked his sister's rice fields, and finally smashed the roof of the hall where she was weaving.
spoken: Soo-sah-no-oh raged across heaven, wrecked his sister's rice fields, and finally smashed the roof of the hall where she was weaving.

pauzy.uwaga: brak pauzy w nagraniu — zostaje bez pauzy
